title: PhD Researcher Van Vollenhoven Institute for Law, Governance and Society (1.0 FTE)
institution: Leiden University, Van Vollenhoven Institute for Law, Governance and Society
about: Four-year, 1.0 FTE PhD position in the Minaret Project at Leiden's Van Vollenhoven Institute, studying constitutional reform in post-imperial Muslim-majority societies, with expected fieldwork in Jordan, Lebanon and Syria and two secondments abroad. Start autumn 2027.
requirements: MSc or LLM in a social science, law or a related field
Empirical research experience and familiarity with socio-legal methods
MSCA Doctoral Network mobility rule applies

upskill.name: EduCut AI Academy course catalog
why: No catalog course covers socio-legal or empirical legal research methods; the shortlist (LLM courses matched only on "governance") is not a genuine match, so the post links to the Academy catalog.
